item.description:
Release v5.21.0

Changes since v5.20.0

  • feat: make content footer resizable
  • feat(activity-bar): hide content footer for non-editor plugins
  • feat(conversation-input): support dropping directories into chat input
  • feat(factory-lumi): sync native window appearance after theme change
  • feat(plugin-code-editor): sync editor theme with Lumi themes
  • feat(plugin-editor-preview): conditionally show content footer based on preview state
  • fix(kitllm): reject incomplete streaming responses
  • fix(project-files): preserve double-click events
